meta.description: Jump into fast-paced action with TOKYO SCRAMBLE, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Sneak and survive through chaotic city streets as you evade danger.

content.value: Deep underground, only the strong survive
In this survival puzzle action game set deep below Tokyo, clear thinking and split-second decisions could mean the difference between life and death.
Observe your enemies to learn their strengths and weaknesses, then wait for an opening to make your escape. Keep out of sight and hold your breath as you search for a path to safety!

When Anne awakens after an accident, she finds herself in a network of subterranean caverns overrun by Zino—mysterious creatures that resemble dinosaurs. Left stranded in this hostile environment where only the strong survive, Anne's only hope is to find a way back to the surface.

This in-game device that can interact with a variety of objects via downloaded apps. From vending machines and crossing signals to Ferris wheels and cranes, almost any device Anne sees can be a part of her strategy. Make the most of each stage's app interactions to distract foes, spring traps, and secure your escape route!

Play as Anne, an upbeat high schooler with an intense passion for music. Through sheer misfortune, Anne falls into a mysterious underground world teeming with monsters called Zino. Armed with her quick wits and undaunted spirit, she'll stop at nothing to get back to the surface.
Anne's older brother and a professional dancer in the Tokyo metropolitan area. Kind and reliable, Ray has appointed himself Anne's protector and will race to her rescue in times of need.

Encounter a diverse and deadly roster of Zino—powerful, ferocious, dinosaur-like creatures. Just as humans have flourished as masters of the world above, so too have the Zino as masters of the forgotten underground world of Zipang.
Green monsters reminiscent of goblins from fairy tales. Their rapid, vicious attacks make them an ever-present threat.
No sound escapes these keen hunters. A single drop of sweat—or even just breathing—can mean certain death when they are around.
If they see you, they will find you, and they will kill you. Once these evil-eyed demons have you in their sights, it's already too late.
A shadowy fish-like creature that slices and dices. As dangerous and stealthy as the blade of a ninja.
The path forward is blocked by their mountainous bodies. Their tough exterior repels any and all attacks.
It skitters nimbly along the ground to deliver the kiss of death to its prey. Escaping its desire is easier said than done.
A monstrous, bird-like monster that jumps and flits around the area. It hunts down its prey with an obsessive, almost childlike fervor.
A majestic tyrant who reigns supreme deep within the earth. It wields its incredible authority and intelligence to incite war in Zipang.
A prehistoric world comes roaring back
Put your survival skills to the test as you try to navigate 22 levels of a forgotten world to reach the surface.
Bare steel girders spanning a cavernous abyss. Watch your balance, because one wrong step will mean a fatal fall.
Caverns wreathed in fog so thick, you can't see where you're going or where you came from. You'll have to rely on your ears to find the way forward, all while an unseen threat stalks ever closer.
A bizarre, anachronistic realm home to both a modern-day amusement park and ancient Japanese architecture. Navigate the chaos carefully!
Wisdom and quick thinking are paramount in this mode. Cling to hope, and escape the underground!
Your chances of survival are slim. Can you escape from the depths of despair in this mode?

Up to four people can play together from their own systems—even with just one game—using the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system’s GameShare feature. You can distribute the controls between everyone or give a single player full control. Players who are not in control will automatically be assigned a cursor.

*Nintendo Switch 2 system must initiate GameShare session. Users who receive software via GameShare can only play the software during the session in which it was shared. Shared game will not be playable after the session ends. Nintendo Switch 2 and GameChat required for each user engaging in GameShare via GameChat. Internet, Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features, including GameChat. During the GameChat open-access period, GameChat can be used without a membership. Not available in all countries. Terms and GameChat requirements apply. support.nintendo.com

Story
One day, high schooler Anne is on her way to meet up with friends, when her subway car abruptly plunges through a fissure in the earth. When the 18-year-old comes to, she finds herself in a strange and unfamiliar land.

Unbeknownst to Tokyo’s residents, an underground world lies beneath their city's surface. Terrifying creatures that evolved from dinosaurs roam this unknown place, creatures that Anne nicknames "Zino."

Trapped amongst them, any sound she makes might as well be a dinner bell...but Anne isn't about to become Zino food!

She’ll need her wits, her trusty smartwatch, and the support of her friends to make it out—or she’ll be the one to end up extinct!

Experience
TOKYO SCRAMBLE is a survival puzzle action game set deep underground.

When Anne awakens after an accident, she finds herself in a network of subterranean caverns overrun by Zino—mysterious creatures that resemble dinosaurs. Left stranded in this hostile environment where only the strong survive, Anne's only hope is to find a way back to the surface.

As her journey continues, Anne comes face-to-face with a diverse and deadly array of Zino. With her sights set on the light filtering in from above, Anne must rely on her wits to flee, distract, and fight back however she can. But does she have what it takes to escape this prehistoric world alive?

Features
Multi-Genre Action Gameplay
• Stealth: Avoid enemies by moving quietly and staying out of sight.
• Strategy: Use apps to distract and outwit foes.
• Combat: Anticipate enemy attacks and strike back using apps.

A Sensory-Rich Experience
• Timing, quick thinking, and unwavering determination form the border between life and death.
• Though the controls are simple, players must contend with enemies' senses of sight and hearing, manage Anne's heart rate, and carefully time their use of apps well in order to survive.

Rich Supporting Elements
• An engaging teen drama about four friends and their dreams for the future, told across a series of text messages.
• Elaborate and diverse environments to traverse that differ between episodes.
• Unique musical themes for each new enemy.
